input:
Um, if I recall correctly, could you treat that string down below as an escaped byte string? I’m looking for its decoded form, printed exactly as is:
\033]8;;https://example.com/x\033\\click here\033]8;;\033\\
reply:
Here’s the decoded form of your escaped byte string, shown in two ways.

1) Visual form (with actual OSC/ESC characters, but note they may render invisibly in chat):
[ESC] ] 8 ; ; https://example.com/x [ESC] \ click here [ESC] ] 8 ; ; [ESC] \

2) Safe, explicit representation (useful if you need to copy-paste):
\x1b]8;;https://example.com/x\x1b\\click here\x1b]8;;\x1b\\

Explanation:
- \x1b denotes the ESC character (0x1B).
- The sequence uses OSC 8 for a hyperlink: ESC ] 8 ; ; URL ESC \ (ST) to start, then the clickable text, then ESC ] 8 ; ; ESC \ to end.
